messages:
Maya: RC candidate ready: build 2026.03.21-rc4 for model-serving. Pin applied: model-serving:v3.2.1-rc4. Target promo window 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC. QA perf / SRE please ack. Release notes: minor KV-cache fix, quant-profile adjustments, GC tweak.
Josiah: quick question — does this touch DB migrations?
Maya: no DB schema changes. only runtime flags + quant config. safe for immediate canary.
Olivia: started smoke tests on staging. will post perf numbers in ~10m. kv-warm script kicked.
deploy-bot: RC created: model-serving:v3.2.1-rc4
artifact: sha256:abc123def456...
pin: applied to candidate pool
canary route: 2% traffic
commands: /promote rc 1749990001 --to prod --pin=true
Josiah: noted. can we pre-warm KV and prefix caches?
Maya: yes, kv warm job run: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --pool=candidate` — finished 2m ago.
Olivia: smoke results: latency p95 = 142ms (baseline 150ms), error rate 0.01% :thumbsup: 
sheriff-ops: telemetry quick look: no anomalies in spans or model outputs. memory stable. recommend proceed to canary.
Kai: I'll open the promo window at 18:00 UTC. Leaving 30m quiet window before full shift. Anyone object?
Josiah: none from infra side.
Maya: thumbs up from PM/QA.
Kai: /promote rc 1749990001 --stage canary --traffic 10 --rollback-on error_rate>0.5
(deploy-bot pls)
deploy-bot: Promotion started -> canary stage
traffic -> 10%
notified oncall -> @sheriff-ops
rollback policy active: error_rate>0.5 or p95>400ms for 5m
monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/rc-1749990001
Olivia: canary at 10% now. watching logs. kv warm holds.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic stable for 10m. metrics: error_rate 0.02%, p95 148ms. proceeding to staged ramp.
Kai: ramping to 50% now. leave 15m between ramps.
Josiah: adding note — if we hit increased memory on node-type A, fallback to quant-profile B.
ops playbook snippet:
```
kubectl set env deployment/model-serving QUANT_PROFILE=B
```
Maya: documented rollback steps in release notes + ops runbook. Also set autoscale min=2 for candidate pool during promo.
Olivia: smoke after 50% ramp: p95 155ms, error_rate 0.03% — holding.
sheriff-ops: observed small spike traced to warmup, settled. ok to full promote in 10.
Kai: promoting to 100% now. /promote rc 1749990001 --to prod --confirm
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod initiated. stage: full
estimated completion ~4m
change window: 18:00-19:00 UTC
post-promote checks running.
Olivia: post-promote health: p95 160ms, error 0.04% — within SLO.
Josiah: tagging release notes and CI artifacts:
- CHANGELOG: kv-cache perf improvements
- Rollback cmd: `scripts/rollback_rc.sh 1749990001`
- Model pin: model-serving:v3.2.1-rc4
Maya: thanks all. I'll file a short readout and close the thread after 1h stable.
Kai: great job. :party_parrot:
